adopt: Point it at a directory of log files and ask what is failing most.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Log data is almost never missing. It is written diligently, durably, in structured form -- and then nothing indexes it, so the only way to ask a question is to grep gigabytes by hand and hope you guess the right string. A directory past a few hundred megabytes is functionally write-only: every producer works, every file is current, and nobody can answer "what broke on Tuesday". The failure has no error and no alert, because nothing failed -- something merely never got read.

Install
python AitherOS/dev/tools/awlog.py --help
synopsis: Ask your logs what is actually failing, instead of grepping them.
